content.short: DefiLlama is the largest TVL aggregator and analytics platform for DeFi, providing transparent open-source data across all chains including Mantle.
content.description: DefiLlama is the most trusted source of Total Value Locked (TVL) and DeFi analytics data across all major blockchain networks, aggregating on-chain data from hundreds of protocols with a focus on accuracy and transparent methodology. The platform offers tools for comparing yields, bridges, stablecoins, and DEX volumes across chains, making it the go-to analytics resource for the DeFi community. DefiLlama tracks all Mantle Network protocols and is fully open-source, maintained by a community of contributors.
content.meta: DefiLlama is the leading DeFi TVL aggregator and analytics platform tracking all Mantle protocols. Discover DefiLlama on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
